story.iWant: to see my typing speed and accuracy in real-time
story.soThat: I can monitor my performance during practice sessions
story.tasks:
- [ ] Implement real-time WPM calculation system (AC: 1) - [ ] Add WPM calculation logic: (typed_characters / 5) / minutes_elapsed - [ ] Create 100ms update interval using useEffect and setInterval - [ ] Update WPM state in real-time during typing - [ ] Add WPM display component with real-time updates - [ ] Ensure WPM calculation handles edge cases (early typing, pauses)
- [ ] Implement accuracy percentage calculation (AC: 1) - [ ] Add accuracy calculation: (correct_characters / total_characters) × 100 - [ ] Track correct vs incorrect character counts in state - [ ] Update accuracy percentage in real-time - [ ] Handle accuracy calculation for edge cases (zero characters) - [ ] Add accuracy display component with visual indicators
- [ ] Implement character-level statistics tracking (AC: 1) - [ ] Add state variables for correctChars, incorrectChars, totalChars - [ ] Update character counts on each keystroke - [ ] Recalculate counts on backspace operations - [ ] Track character-level errors for analysis - [ ] Add character statistics display component
- [ ] Implement net WPM calculation (AC: 2) - [ ] Add net WPM formula accounting for errors - [ ] Calculate net WPM: WPM - (error_penalty) - [ ] Update net WPM in real-time during session - [ ] Include net WPM in final session results
- [ ] Implement session completion metrics (AC: 2) - [ ] Calculate final metrics when session ends - [ ] Display comprehensive results screen - [ ] Store performance data to Firebase Firestore - [ ] Include all metrics in session document - [ ] Trigger completion callback with metrics data
- [ ] Add comprehensive testing for metrics calculation (AC: 1, 2) - [ ] Add tests for WPM calculation accuracy - [ ] Add tests for accuracy percentage calculation - [ ] Add tests for net WPM calculation - [ ] Add tests for character statistics tracking - [ ] Add tests for session completion metrics - [ ] Verify performance requirements (100ms update frequency)
- [ ] Integrate metrics with existing TypingEngine component (AC: 1, 2) - [ ] Extend TypingEngine state with metrics variables - [ ] Integrate metrics calculation into existing event handlers - [ ] Add metrics display to existing TypingEngine UI - [ ] Ensure compatibility with existing cursor and validation systems - [ ] Maintain <50ms typing latency performance requirement

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Given I am actively typing, when I type characters, then WPM is calculated and displayed in real-time and accuracy percentage updates continuously and character-level statistics are tracked.
2. Given a typing session ends, when the session completes, then final WPM, accuracy, and net WPM are calculated and correct vs incorrect character counts are displayed and performance data is stored for historical tracking.
